# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of LPCF on Modrinth. Older releases may not receive patches.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/LPCF/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue or pull request with exploit details before maintainers have had a chance to investigate and release a fix.

Include:

- Affected plugin version
- Server software and Minecraft version
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact assessment

You should receive an acknowledgment when the report is reviewed. If the issue is accepted, a fix will be prepared and a coordinated disclosure can follow the release.
